nodes.description: msg.sender - caller-controlled address used for owner assignment, balance indexing, allowance indexing and ETH refunds
block.timestamp/block-level value - block data used for pseudo-randomness in rand() and for timing checks in refundGameAfterLongInactivity()
SafeMath.add(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal constant - checked addition with assert(c >= a)
SafeMath.sub(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal constant - checked subtraction with assert(b <= a)
SafeMath.mul(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal constant - checked multiplication with assert(a == 0 || c / a == b)
SafeMath.div(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal constant - division, throws automatically on divide by zero
BasicToken.transfer(address _to, uint256 _value) - moves tokens from msg.sender balances to _to using SafeMath add/sub
BasicToken.balanceOf(address _owner) constant - returns balances[_owner]
StandardToken.transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint256 _value) - spends allowance and updates both balances
StandardToken.approve(address _spender, uint256 _value) - sets allowed[msg.sender][_spender] with require that value is 0 or existing allowance is 0
StandardToken.allowance(address _owner, address _spender) constant - reads allowed mapping
Ownable() constructor - assigns owner = msg.sender, the root of the access control model
Ownable.transferOwnership(address newOwner) onlyOwner - transfers contract ownership to a non-zero address
Pausable.pause() onlyOwner whenNotPaused returns (bool) - sets paused = true
Pausable.unpause() onlyOwner whenPaused returns (bool) - sets paused = false
SlotTicket.mint(address _to, uint256 _amount) onlyOwner - increases totalSupply and credits balances[_to]
SlotTicket.destroy() onlyOwner - transfers ETH to owner and terminates via selfdestruct
Slot(address _wallet) payable constructor - deploys SlotTicket, sets wallet, jackpotAmount = msg.value, gameNumber/gameStarted/counter and undestroyable
function() payable fallback - buys tickets for msg.sender via buyTicketsFor(msg.sender)
Slot.buyTicketsFor(address beneficiary) whenNotPaused payable - computes ticket count from msg.value, mints tokens, adds participant and returns change
Slot.addParticipant(address _participant, uint256 _numberOfTickets) private - loop storing participants and triggering awardPrizes/distributeRemaining/increaseGame when a game fills
Slot.rand(uint32 _size) constant private - pseudo-random from keccak256(blockhash(block.number-1), blockhash(block.number-100)) % _size
Slot.awardPrizes() private - picks winner index, checks jackpot, loops prizes and transfers ETH to winner addresses
Slot.distributeJackpot(uint256 _winnerIndex) private - transfers jackpotAmount to the winner and zeroes it
Slot.distributeRemaining() private - adds 250 finney to jackpot, sends 249 finney to wallet and 1 finney gas refund to msg.sender
Slot.increaseGame() private - increments gameNumber and resets gameStarted to block.number
Slot.refundGameAfterLongInactivity() - refunds PRICE to each participant of a stale game after INACTIVITY blocks, then reduces counter and increases the game
Slot.destroy() onlyOwner - requires !undestroyable, destroys the token and selfdestructs to owner
Slot.changeWallet(address _newWallet) onlyOwner - updates the wallet address used for cash-out transfers
Slot.makeUndestroyable() onlyOwner - permanently sets undestroyable = true
selfdestruct(owner) executed inside Slot.destroy - irreversible termination of the game contract
selfdestruct(owner) executed inside SlotTicket.destroy - irreversible termination of the token contract
msg.sender.transfer(change) external ETH call at the end of buyTicketsFor - callee reentrancy surface
participants[gameNumber][winnerIndex%SIZE].transfer(prizes[i]) external ETH calls in the awardPrizes loop - winner addresses receive funds and can reenter
participants[gameNumber][_winnerIndex].transfer(jackpotAmount) external ETH call in distributeJackpot before jackpotAmount is zeroed
wallet.transfer(249 finney) external ETH call in distributeRemaining
msg.sender.transfer(1 finney) gas refund external ETH call in distributeRemaining
participants[gameNumber][i].transfer(PRICE) loop of external ETH calls in refundGameAfterLongInactivity - participants can reenter
keccak256(blockhash(block.number-1), blockhash(block.number-100)) % _size - miner/buyer influenceable pseudo-randomness enabling winner manipulation
uint256 public totalSupply declared in ERC20Basic, increased by mint
mapping(address => uint256) balances in BasicToken, credited/debited by transfer, transferFrom and mint
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) allowed in StandardToken, the allowance ledger
address public owner in Ownable - privileged address checked by the onlyOwner modifier
bool public paused in Pausable, gates buyTicketsFor through whenNotPaused
string public name = "Slot Ticket" token metadata
uint8 public decimals = 0 token metadata
string public symbol = "SLOT" token metadata
string public version = "0.1" token metadata
SlotTicket public token in Slot - the separately deployed receipt token controlled by the game
mapping(uint => mapping(uint => address)) participants - game number to counter to player address, indexed for picking winners
uint256[8] prizes fixed array of payout amounts (4 ether down to 500 finney)
uint256 public jackpotAmount - accumulating jackpot balance paid on a jackpot win
uint256 public gameNumber - index of the current lottery game
uint256 public gameStarted - block number when the current game started, used for inactivity refunds
bool public undestroyable - one-way flag disabling Slot.destroy
address wallet - house wallet receiving the 249 finney cut per completed game
uint256 counter - monotonically-ish increasing ticket counter reduced by refunds and reset per SIZE
parameter _to of BasicToken.transfer - recipient of the token transfer
parameter _value of BasicToken.transfer - amount of tokens to move
parameter _from of StandardToken.transferFrom - account debited
parameter _to of StandardToken.transferFrom - account credited
parameter _value of StandardToken.transferFrom - amount of tokens to move
parameter _spender of StandardToken.approve - address granted an allowance
parameter _value of StandardToken.approve - allowance amount granted
parameter _owner of StandardToken.allowance - owner queried
parameter _spender of StandardToken.allowance - spender queried
parameter _owner of BasicToken.balanceOf - account whose balance is read
parameter newOwner of Ownable.transferOwnership - address receiving ownership
parameter _wallet of the Slot constructor - house wallet address
parameter beneficiary of Slot.buyTicketsFor - address that receives the minted tickets/participant slots
parameter _participant of Slot.addParticipant - address recorded into the participants mapping
parameter _numberOfTickets of Slot.addParticipant - loop bound for slot insertion
parameter _size of Slot.rand - modulus applied to the blockhash pseudo-random value
parameter _winnerIndex of Slot.distributeJackpot - participant index awarded the jackpot
parameter _newWallet of Slot.changeWallet - replacement house wallet
parameter a of SafeMath.mul - multiplicand
parameter b of SafeMath.mul - multiplier
parameter a of SafeMath.sub - minuend
parameter b of SafeMath.sub - subtrahend
parameter a of SafeMath.add - first addend
parameter b of SafeMath.add - second addend
local variable change = msg.value % PRICE in buyTicketsFor - remainder refunded to msg.sender
local variable numberOfTickets in buyTicketsFor - quantity of tickets purchased
local loop counter i in addParticipant - iterates over purchased tickets
local variable winnerIndex in awardPrizes - starting index of the prize winners, incremented per prize
local variable jackpotWon in awardPrizes - boolean flag with 1-in-a-million probability
local loop counter i in awardPrizes - iterates over the prizes array
local variable _allowance in transferFrom - cached allowed[_from][msg.sender] value
local variable c = a * b in SafeMath.mul - product validated by assertion

a winner address receiving prize ETH can reenter buyTicketsFor through its fallback before game state is finalized
a winner address can reenter refundGameAfterLongInactivity while counter/game state is still being updated

a refunded participant can reenter refundGameAfterLongInactivity before counter is reduced and the game is increased
the wallet transfer in distributeRemaining is an external call that could reenter the payout logic
msg.sender receiving the change can reenter buyTicketsFor through its payable fallback
